hints.content:
$h'(x)>0$ means $h$ is **increasing**.

$h'(x)<0$ means $h$ is **decreasing**.

$h''(x)>0$ means the slope of $h$ is increasing ($h$ is **concave up**).

$h''(x)<0$ means the slope of $h$ is decreasing ($h$ is **concave down**).

| | $h'(x)>0$ | $h'(x)<0$
:- | :- | :-: | :-:
| | $h$ is **increasing** | $h$ is **decreasing**
$h''(x)>0$ | $h$ is **concave up** |  ![A curve moves upward with increasing steepness.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/fad1dc95cd761b6e7f4c581c7093841fcf16029a) | ![A curve moves downward with decreasing steepness.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/88e8d1ff71cbe909ea256814c06e1ff2df39bd5e)
$h''(x)<0$ | $h$ is **concave down** | ![A curve moves upward with decreasing steepness.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/f9425dbee4d4f73f6188a62f88f637018843d7c8) | ![A curve moves downward with increasing steepness.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/4d64d76d6423a90abf605dfe2b856e7327f92a0c)

We are asked to find an interval where $h'(x)<0$ and $h''(x)<0$, so we need an interval where the graph of $h$ has this general shape:

 ![A curve moves downward with increasing steepness.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/4d64d76d6423a90abf605dfe2b856e7327f92a0c)

Visually, this is where $h'(x)<0$ and $h''(x)<0$.

![The graph of function h has a portion of the curve highlighted. The portion of the curve moves downward concave down, starting at about (0.5, 11).](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/e24de70ae612cae71a70a5afac6de4a24896af83)

Now we can check each option:

Interval | Shape | Is $h'(x)<0$ and $h''(x)<0$?
:-: | :-: | :-:
$-4.5<x<-3$  | ![A curve moves upward with increasing steepness.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/842593fcfd6a52a51cd66950f88ff7cd344d7af3) | $\redD{\text{No}}$. $h'(x)>0$ and $h''(x)>0$.
$-1.5<x<0$ | ![A curve moves upward with decreasing steepness.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/422cf5924dbecfc98054d87696663b0145ce07e6) | $\redD{\text{No}}$. $h''(x)<0$ but $h'(x)>0$.
$1<x<3$ | ![A curve moves downward with increasing steepness.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/08e8b7e5ce7d160e69c506cebdd2552cb4f57715) | $\greenD{\text{Yes!}}$
